watch.en: Let the food rest in the acidic marinade; the acid works on the protein.
watch.de: Das Gargut in der sauren Marinade ruhen lassen; die Säure wirkt auf das Eiweiß.

why.en: A marinade helps slowly cooked beef keep flavour and tenderness, and its acid changes the protein, a kind of cooking without heat.
why.de: Eine Marinade hilft langsam gegartem Rindfleisch zu Geschmack und Zartheit, und ihre Säure verändert das Eiweiß, eine Art Garen ohne Hitze.

sources.title: Garde Manger: A Guide to the Cold Kitchen (Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: In the simplest form, it means that the acid is changing the protein into a form that in many cases is edible.

sources.title: Garde Manger: A Guide to the Cold Kitchen (Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Think of this as “cooking without heat”.

sources.title: Meat Cutting and Processing for Food Service (BC Campus)
sources.sentence: Using marinades or moist heat methods like steaming or stewing will help ensure flavor & tenderness.
